account.title: Sign in with PetSafe
account.description: Sign in with your PetSafe app email and password to find your feeder. PetSafe FreshFeed then connects to the feeder directly on your local network; Tuya Local is not needed. The password is used for this one sign-in and is never stored. After each attempt wait 60 seconds before trying again.

data_description.country: The region your PetSafe app account was created in.

feeder.title: Choose your feeder
feeder.description: Your account has more than one FreshFeed feeder. Choose the one to add.

host.title: Feeder address
host.description: The feeder was not found on the local network, or it did not accept the local connection at that address. Enter its local IPv4 address (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x, or 192.168.x.x), for example from your router's client list.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: PetSafe FreshFeed connects to the feeder directly on your local network, with the local key from your PetSafe account; Tuya Local is not used. Before anything is saved, one read-only status check confirms the connection. The feeder is added read-only: no commands are sent to it. Controls are a separate, explicit step afterwards.

reconfigure.title: Feeder address
reconfigure.description: Enter the feeder's new local IPv4 address (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x, or 192.168.x.x). The entry is stopped while one read-only status check confirms the new address, then started again. Only the address changes: the entry, its device, its entities, its history and its controls store are kept.

error.invalid_auth: The email or password was not accepted. Check them in the PetSafe app.
error.challenge_required: The account needs an extra verification step or is locked. Sign in with the PetSafe app first, then use "Use an existing Tuya Local entry" if this keeps failing.
error.unsupported_region: Sign-in for this region or app version is not supported.
error.timeout: The PetSafe service did not answer in time.
error.cannot_connect: The PetSafe service could not be reached or sent an unexpected answer.
error.no_feeders: No supported FreshFeed feeder was found in this account.
error.invalid_host: Enter a private IPv4 address (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x, or 192.168.x.x).
error.local_admission_failed: The feeder did not accept a read-only local connection at this address with the key from your PetSafe account. Check the address and that the feeder is powered and on the same network. Nothing was saved.

abort.no_source: No tuya_local PetSafe FreshFeed device found.
abort.already_configured: This FreshFeed device is already configured.
abort.tuya_local_conflict: A Tuya Local entry for this feeder is enabled and already holds its local connection. Use "Use an existing Tuya Local entry (legacy)", or disable that Tuya Local entry first.
abort.unsupported_local_configuration: The feeder's local protocol or address is not supported. Only local protocol 3.5 at a private IPv4 address is supported; nothing was saved.
abort.invalid_local_configuration: The feeder's local connection details from the account are not valid; nothing was saved.
abort.binding_unavailable: The tuya_local FreshFeed device registry entry could not be identified; controls were not enabled.
abort.provision_failed: The retained-intent store could not be created. Nothing was saved; an existing partial store is left untouched for manual recovery.
abort.account_unavailable: Sign in with PetSafe is not available in this installation. Use "Use an existing Tuya Local entry".
abort.already_in_progress: Another setup for this feeder is in progress. Finish or close it, then try again.
abort.aborted: Setup was stopped. Nothing was saved.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The feeder address was updated and the entry was started again.
abort.reconfigure_unsupported: Only entries that connect to the feeder directly can change their address here. For a Tuya Local entry, change the address in Tuya Local.
abort.reconfigure_in_progress: This entry is already being reconfigured.
abort.unload_failed: The entry could not be stopped safely (for example a command is still settling), so nothing was changed. Try again later.
abort.migration_pending: This entry has an unfinished migration; finish or cancel it first.

data_description.enable_controls: Creates a local retained-intent store once. Controls stay locked after every restart until you check the feeder and clear any uncertain command.

migrate.title: Connect directly to the feeder
migrate.description: PetSafe FreshFeed will connect to the feeder itself, using the local key already saved in the selected Tuya Local entry, and keep this entry, its device, its entities, its history and its controls store. Step 1 (now): controls stop, the Tuya Local entry is disabled (not deleted) and the feeder is unavailable. Then restart Home Assistant and choose Continue the migration. When the device moves to PetSafe FreshFeed, these {count} Tuya Local entities are removed: {retiring}. Until that move you can cancel; after it the migration only goes forward. No feeder command is sent.

migrate_host.title: Feeder address for the direct connection
migrate_host.description: The Tuya Local entry uses a host name or automatic protocol, which a direct connection does not use. Enter the feeder's local IPv4 address (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x, or 192.168.x.x) and its local protocol.

resume.title: Continue the migration
resume.description: Continues after the restart: one read-only status check confirms the direct connection, then the device moves to PetSafe FreshFeed and the connection is checked again. If the feeder's address changed, enter its new local IPv4 address; otherwise leave it empty. Only if the device already moved and the Tuya Local entry was deleted or changed, also enter the feeder's local key; otherwise leave it empty. No feeder command is sent.

cancel.title: Cancel the migration
cancel.description: Restores the Tuya Local connection (re-enabling its entry if it was enabled before) and keeps this entry on it. Only possible before the device moved. A new migration can be started later from these options.

remove_source.title: Remove the retired Tuya Local entry
remove_source.description: The direct connection was verified and has persisted across a restart. This removes only the retired Tuya Local entry for this feeder; the Tuya Local integration itself is not uninstalled. Keep it if another device still uses Tuya Local.

error.invalid_host: Enter a private IPv4 address (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x, or 192.168.x.x).
error.unsupported_local_configuration: Only local protocol 3.5 at a private IPv4 address is supported.

abort.controls_already_enabled: Controls are already enabled for this entry.
abort.binding_unavailable: The FreshFeed device registry entry could not be identified; controls were not enabled. A new entry must have loaded once before controls can be enabled.
abort.provision_failed: The retained-intent store could not be created. Nothing was saved; an existing partial store is left untouched for manual recovery.
abort.migration_pending: This entry has an unfinished migration; finish or cancel it first.
abort.migration_restart_required: Controls are stopped and the Tuya Local entry is disabled. Restart Home Assistant, then open these options again and choose Continue the migration.
abort.migration_ready_to_resume: The migration can continue: open these options again and choose Continue the migration.
abort.migration_forward_repair_required: The device already moved to PetSafe FreshFeed, but the direct connection could not be confirmed. Controls stay stopped. Check that the feeder is powered and reachable, then choose Continue the migration again (optionally with its current address).
abort.migration_complete: Done. PetSafe FreshFeed now connects directly to the feeder; this entry, its device, its entities, its history and its controls store were kept.
abort.migration_cancelled: The migration was cancelled; this entry uses Tuya Local again.
abort.migration_refused: Nothing was changed by this step. The migration could not safely continue (for example the old connection is still running, the Tuya Local entry changed, or the feeder did not answer a read-only check). Controls stay stopped while a migration is open.
abort.migration_already_migrating: This entry already has a migration.
abort.migration_ambiguous_source: The Tuya Local entry or its device could not be identified uniquely (another entry or device names the same feeder), so nothing was changed.
abort.migration_unsupported_shape: The Tuya Local entry's connection details are not supported for a direct connection (only a single feeder, local protocol 3.5 and a private IPv4 address), so nothing was changed.
abort.migration_unsupported_version: Migration is supported only on Home Assistant 2026.10; nothing was changed.
abort.migration_storage_unavailable: The migration record or the controls store could not be read safely, so nothing was changed.
abort.migration_operation_active: A command is still settling; try again once it has finished.
